profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Tech Lead | C# · Unity · C++ | Accessible 3D Simulation | AI-Assisted Engineering | Creator of Kalipso, a custom engine language
profile.summary:
I lead a 17-person cross-functional squad (simulation engineering, narrative design, audio, learning design, nursing education, UX) building Shadow Health, a nursing simulation platform used by students at universities nationwide. I set technical direction alongside product and design, and I treat accessibility as architecture, not a late-stage fix. 

What that has produced: an in-engine accessibility stack (custom screen reader, immersive audio description, full keyboard navigation) that gives blind and deaf students equal access to virtual clinical training, presented at CSUN 2026. A UIToolkit framework that moved 6 products onto a new UI pipeline. A migration approach that cut product migration time from 3 quarters to 1. And engineering lead on HESI CPRA, the first assessment of its kind for nursing practice readiness.

I’m an early adopter of AI-assisted engineering: I introduced Claude Code standards and skills that most of our simulation developers now use daily. Nearly ten years across Unity/C#, Unreal/C++, tools and pipelines, including managing a programming department.

Outside work I design and build Kalipso, a self-hosting systems language with its own compiler, rendering engine, IDE and UI system build in the language by the language, targeting native and WebAssembly. Accessibility is built into the component system by construction. Read more about it on my website: https://ericcrozier.com/#kalipso/overview

 Core: C# · Unity (UIToolkit, WebGL)  · Accessibility · Technical leadership · AI-assisted development

honors.title: Health Markets Bronze Coin
honors.description:
Awarded the Bronze Coin by peers. Award Message:

Eric Crozier has consistently demonstrated having a bias for acting fast and pivoting if wrong. He has exemplified a strong bias for action and adaptability in his engineering leadership role on the Clinical Practice Readiness Assessment (CPRA) project. His pivotal role in integrating NCLEX style assessments into our Shadow Health simulation through the QuAD platform and implementing a new UI architecture using Unity3D's UIToolkit significantly enhanced our software's performance, stability, and ease of maintenance. His proactive and agile approach contributed directly to the successful CPRA pilot, marked by improved scalability and efficient content updates. His ability to coordinate with multiple teams and his dedication to knowledge-sharing have been crucial in maintaining project momentum and achieving exemplary outcomes, reinforcing our commitment to delivering the right results.
